references.text: Joshua also sent spies to explore the land, showing a pattern in Israel where spies were sent out before military operations
Moses sent spies from each tribe to explore the land of Canaan, similar missions that the tribe of Dan carried out
Describes how the tribe of Dan took Laish and settled there, which is the result of this spying mission
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol, the same cities from which the spies came
Introduces Micah and his household whom the spies reached, and provides background for the idolatry they found
The Amorites pressed the children of Dan up into the mountains and would not let them come down to the valley, explaining why they sought new territory
Zorah and Eshtaol are mentioned as cities in Judah's inheritance, but they were also associated with Dan
